environment_room.title: Choose a room for environmental science
environment_room.description: Configure extra sensors and assumptions for one selected room. All are optional. The basic Home Environment Manager features work without any of them.

data_description.environment_area: Only the selected room is edited. Return here to configure another room.

environment_room_air.title: Room: {area_name} - ventilation and moisture
environment_room_air.description: Room air volume and sensors. Rated particle CADR belongs to each purifier device.

data.co2_ndir_verified: CO₂ sensor has verified real NDIR hardware

data_description.temperature_entity: Choose the measured ambient air temperature of this room, not an external sensor. Used for room science and moisture calculations when multiple sources exist.
data_description.room_volume_m3: Measured indoor air volume in m³ (usable floor area multiplied by ceiling height). Required to estimate nominal clean-air changes from purifier CADR.
data_description.particle_cadr_m3h: Manufacturer-rated particle clean-air delivery rate in m³/h at the selected fan speed, not simple fan airflow. Filter performance for gases is not inferred.
data_description.purifier_entity: Choose the purifier's real power/fan state. The environmental analysis can describe nominal filtration while the device is running; merely selecting it does not switch it on.
data_description.extractor_entity: Select the existing mechanical extraction fan/switch for contextual humidity-event advice. A humidity rise alone does not prove a shower or cooking event.
data_description.co2_ndir_verified: Enable only after independently verifying that the selected CO₂ source is true NDIR or equivalent measured hardware, not estimated eCO₂ derived from VOC.
data_description.co2_target_ppm: Operational CO₂ target in ppm for ventilation effectiveness suggestions. Reaching it does not certify pathogen safety or other indoor pollutants.
data_description.sleep_room: Mark this room as a sleeping area for interpreting nighttime overheating and noise, where sufficient sensor history exists. This does not independently detect sleep.

environment_room_exposure.title: Room: {area_name} - optional specialist sensors
environment_room_exposure.description: Optional. Select only sensors actually measuring the requested pollutant and units. Confirm independent hardware/calibration; synthetic HCHO, eCO₂ and generic sound-level signals are not acceptable substitutes for validated observations. Radon guidelines need nearly a full year of history.

data.radon_sensor_verified: Radon sensor uses dedicated calibrated hardware
data.formaldehyde_sensor_verified: Formaldehyde measurement is real and verified
data.noise_sensor_calibrated: Sound-level sensor delivers equivalent calibrated readings
data.melanopic_spectral_verified: Melanopic EDI comes from a real spectral measurement

data_description.radon_entity: Select a dedicated radon monitor with Bq/m³ or pCi/L output. Use long observation periods to assess exposure; radon is associated with lung cancer risk.
data_description.radon_sensor_verified: Confirm the device really measures radon with dedicated calibrated hardware. Ordinary VOC-based sensors are unsuitable; annual risk estimates need enough history.
data_description.radon_reference_bq_m3: Annual radon screening reference appropriate to local rules. WHO recommends 100 Bq/m³ where feasible (national references differ, not above 300); compare annual averages only.
data_description.formaldehyde_entity: Select a real HCHO sensor measuring formaldehyde (µg/m³ or mg/m³), not a generic VOC-estimated value. Only verified concentration can inform exposure analysis.
data_description.formaldehyde_sensor_verified: Confirm this is a genuine HCHO measurement before using its 30-minute average. WHO short-term guidance is 100 µg/m³ (30 min), not a universal single-reading threshold.
data_description.noise_entity: Choose calibrated A-weighted equivalent sound level in dB(A). The integration uses logarithmic sound-energy averaging; uncalibrated phone peaks are not suitable.
data_description.noise_sensor_calibrated: Enable only if the selected source produces calibrated equivalent levels over known intervals. Peak-only or guessed readings cannot form valid LAeq estimates.
data_description.illuminance_entity: Choose measured photopic illuminance in lux. Useful for describing daylight exposure; ordinary lux cannot establish biological melanopic stimulus.
data_description.melanopic_edi_entity: Select a real spectral sensor providing melanopic equivalent daylight illuminance in lux. Never derive it from ordinary photopic lux with an arbitrary multiplier.
data_description.melanopic_spectral_verified: Confirm independent actual spectral evidence for the melanopic EDI source. The system will not infer it from color temperature or ordinary lux.

environment_room_comfort.title: Room: {area_name} - full thermal comfort (advanced)
environment_room_comfort.description: Optional advanced ISO 7730. Simple automatic comfort requires no clothing, activity, radiant or air-speed inputs.

data_description.enable_pmv: Opt in to ISO 7730 Predicted Mean Vote/Predicted Percentage Dissatisfied analysis. Needs real radiant temperature, air speed, clothing and activity assumptions; off by default.
data_description.radiant_temperature_entity: Measured mean radiant temperature (°C), not ordinary room air temperature. Required for credible PMV/PPD thermal comfort calculations.
data_description.air_speed_entity: True local air-speed sensor in m/s; if provided, it overrides the static estimated airflow value used in PMV/PPD.
data_description.air_speed_m_s: Explicit assumed air speed in m/s only when no real sensor is available. Enter a defensible estimate; results remain labelled as estimated.
data_description.met: Human metabolic activity in met units. Roughly 1.0 for sitting quietly, 1.2 for light desk work; set actual occupant activity, not equipment output.
data_description.clo: Clothing insulation in clo; roughly 0.5 for light summer clothing, 1.0 for common winter clothing. Impacts comfort estimates, not a sensor reading.

pid.title: Climate PID - select a room
pid.description: Optional and disabled by default. Choose exactly one monitored room. A room's PID never controls climate devices in a different assigned Home Assistant area.

data_description.pid_area: Only that room's explicitly selected climate entities may be controlled.

pid_room.title: Climate PID in {area_name} - devices and comfort target
pid_room.description: Enable PID only after selecting real room temperature measurements and the climate devices you authorize. The existing thermostat must already be in heat or cool mode. Windows with open or unknown contacts stop PID commands. No HVAC mode or compressor switching is performed.

data.pid_enabled: Enable supervisory climate PID for this room
data.pid_pause_on_window_open: Pause when any room window is open or unknown

data_description.pid_enabled: Opt in to supervisory PID that adjusts setpoints only on chosen, already operating thermostats. It does not power HVAC on or defeat native compressor controls.
data_description.pid_climate_entities: Exact climate.* devices this room's PID is authorized to adjust. No area-wide broadcast or automatic assignment; manually switched-off devices remain off.
data_description.pid_temperature_entity: Independent room temperature source (°C/°F) refreshed in the last 10 minutes. Stale or unavailable values suspend setpoint commands.
data_description.pid_mode: Choose HEAT or COOL only to match the actual already active thermostat mode. Supervisory PID never switches mode or powers on a compressor.
data_description.pid_target_c: Requested room temperature (°C) used as PID reference. The controller adjusts thermostat setpoints within safety bounds; this does not guarantee comfort.
data_description.pid_pause_on_window_open: Stop new thermostat setpoint changes when a selected room window is open or sensor state unknown. Prevents unwanted heating/cooling while airing.

pid_tuning.title: Climate PID in {area_name} - advanced safety and tuning
pid_tuning.description: Kp in %/°C, Ki in %/(°C·minute), Kd in %·minute/°C. The output only trims the existing thermostat setpoint within a bounded range, at limited intervals. Start with defaults; tune gradually after reviewing room trends. Manual setpoint changes pause PID until you explicitly resume it.

data_description.pid_kp: Proportional PID gain (% per °C): immediate response to room-temperature error. Default 22; too high can cause oscillation and frequent target changes.
data_description.pid_ki: Integral PID gain (% per °C·minute): compensates persistent temperature error. Default 0.25; anti-windup applies, but very high values can overshoot.
data_description.pid_kd: Derivative PID gain (%·minute/°C): responds to filtered temperature change rate. Default 0; high values amplify sensor noise.
data_description.pid_offset_c: Maximum adjustment of the actual thermostat setpoint above heating or below cooling demand (°C). This limits PID authority without changing HVAC mode.
data_description.pid_min_setpoint_c: Hard minimum thermostat setpoint in °C. Device's native minimum and other manufacturer protections still apply.
data_description.pid_max_setpoint_c: Hard maximum thermostat setpoint in °C. Device's native maximum and independent thermal limits still apply.
data_description.pid_sample_seconds: Interval between PID decisions, in seconds. Default 300 seconds and at least 120; it avoids writing on every sensor update.
data_description.pid_max_change_c: Maximum thermostat setpoint step per control cycle (°C), default 0.5. Even a large temperature error cannot bypass this rate limit.
data_description.pid_min_change_c: Smallest meaningful setpoint difference (°C) before issuing a command. Avoids needless small repeated adjustments and device quantization noise.

climate.title: Climate - select room
climate.description: Configure each selected room independently. A fresh room temperature sensor and exact room-assigned actuators are required. Direct relay/PWM is permitted only for independently protected non-compressor loads, with confirmed on/off limits and explicit actuation opt-in. Occupied, unoccupied, away and sleep heating/cooling targets are independent.

data_description.climate_area: This setting governs Room to configure. Physical commands require a separate device opt-in and appropriate protections.

climate_room.title: Climate - controller, occupancy and away
climate_room.description: Configure each selected room independently. A fresh room temperature sensor and exact room-assigned actuators are required. Direct relay/PWM is permitted only for independently protected non-compressor loads, with confirmed on/off limits and explicit actuation opt-in. Occupied, unoccupied, away and sleep heating/cooling targets are independent.

data.climate_enabled: Enable climate planning for this room
data.climate_allow_actuation: Permit commands to the explicitly selected room controllers (separate opt ins)
data.climate_auto_switch_hvac: Automatically switch between supported heat/cool modes (separate opt in)
data.climate_prefer_native_auto: Prefer device's native heat_cool target range when available
data.climate_mode: Heat, cool, off or automatic selection

data_description.climate_enabled: Enables per-room climate planning and status. It does not authorize actuator commands; Allow actuation and each device's separate opt-in are required.
data_description.climate_allow_actuation: Allows commands only through the separately enabled, capability-checked room controllers. Leave off for monitoring/advice only.
data_description.climate_auto_switch_hvac: Separate consent to switch between supported heating and cooling modes, subject to dwell and device interlocks. Does not bypass equipment compressor protection.
data_description.climate_prefer_native_auto: When a thermostat genuinely supports native HEAT_COOL with two target temperatures, prefer its built-in control over simulated mode switching.
data_description.climate_controller: Choose the control strategy supported by installed equipment: native thermostat, or independently protected slow direct actuator. Do not use relays for compressors.
data_description.climate_mode: Heating, cooling, or automatic decision only when those modes truly exist on the device. An unsupported mode remains advisory and does not send commands.
data_description.climate_entity: Select exactly one primary climate.* device assigned to this HA room. It supplies native capabilities; manual OFF or unsupported modes cannot be auto-restarted.
data_description.climate_temperature_entity: Independent fresh temperature sensor (°C or °F) in the same room; stale readings stop target changes. Avoid using an unrelated outdoor or thermostat estimate.
data_description.climate_hysteresis_c: Temperature separation in °C before changing heating/cooling direction. Prevents rapid oscillation; native mode dwell protections also apply.

climate_presence.title: Climate - occupancy, away, sleep and comfort
climate_presence.description: Configure each selected room independently. A fresh room temperature sensor and exact room-assigned actuators are required. Direct relay/PWM is permitted only for independently protected non-compressor loads, with confirmed on/off limits and explicit actuation opt-in. Occupied, unoccupied, away and sleep heating/cooling targets are independent.

data.climate_away_entities: People or device trackers for home/away
data.climate_unknown_occupancy: If occupancy is unknown: assume occupied or hold
data.climate_unoccupied_delay_minutes: Delay before considering a room unoccupied (minutes)
data.climate_occupancy_stale_minutes: Maximum age of last occupancy sensor report (minutes)
data.climate_sleep_active: Sleep profile currently active in this room

data_description.climate_occupancy_sensors: Select actual room presence/occupancy binary sensors. A positive value means occupied; an unavailable sensor does not prove an empty room.
data_description.climate_away_entities: People or device trackers for home/away status. Absence is considered only with explicit, fresh evidence; unknown trackers are treated conservatively.
data_description.climate_unknown_occupancy: When room presence is unknown choose conservative occupied assumptions or hold. Never interpret a missing sensor as permission to power devices off.
data_description.climate_unoccupied_delay_minutes: How long all selected presence sources must continuously indicate vacancy before applying a room-unoccupied temperature profile. Prevents reacting to brief motion gaps.
data_description.climate_occupancy_stale_minutes: Maximum age of presence data in minutes. A sensor older than this cannot prove the room empty or authorize an absence OFF.
data_description.climate_away_policy: Choose whether any resident at home or all selected trackers must report home before assigning the at-home profile. Confirm it matches real household behavior.
data_description.climate_manual_profile: Explicitly override the automatically selected home/unoccupied/away/sleep profile for this room. Use for diagnostics or deliberate preferences; it still obeys safety gates.
data_description.climate_sleep_active: Manual indication that this room currently uses its sleep profile. It is separate from room occupancy and may be superseded by verified shared sleep-room data.
data_description.climate_sleep_schedule_enabled: Enable a local-time sleep interval for this room. This does not detect sleep biologically; it selects a preset schedule.
data_description.climate_sleep_start: Local clock time HH:MM when this room's scheduled sleep profile begins. Must differ from the end time.
data_description.climate_sleep_end: Local clock time HH:MM when the scheduled sleep profile ends. Overnight intervals crossing midnight are supported.
data_description.climate_target_source: Fixed setpoints, small measured-humidity adjustment without guessed clothes/air speed, or advanced ISO 7730 with all verified inputs.
data_description.climate_comfort_adjustment_max_c: Maximum absolute °C offset from the chosen temperature target when the qualified PMV/PPD comfort estimate is available. Avoids uncontrolled target shifts.

climate_equipment.title: Climate - additional equipment and humidity
climate_equipment.description: Select optional extra HVAC, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, extraction and purification fans in this room. The planner checks actual modes and assigns exclusive roles. Secondary devices are advisory only until their safe drivers are verified.

data.climate_heat_climate_entity: Optional dedicated heating climate (radiator / heating zone)
data.climate_cool_climate_entity: Optional dedicated cooling climate (air conditioner / heat pump)
data.climate_dry_climate_entity: Optional climate with native DRY mode
data.climate_humidity_entity: Verified room humidity sensor (choose one if multiple)
data.climate_cooling_dry_deferral_rh_points: Defer separate dehumidification while AC cools until RH exceeds upper limit by these percentage points (0 disables)
data.climate_humidity_setpoint_auto: Allow native humidity setpoint changes on an already-running humidifier (extra opt-in)
data.climate_window_efficiency_notify: Notify when a closed window could help replace active heating, cooling or dehumidification (requires trustworthy outdoor conditions)
data.climate_dry_fan_mode_auto: Allow automatic native AC DRY/FAN_ONLY mode transitions (separate opt-in; requires device commissioning)
data.climate_dry_fan_hardware_confirmed: I confirm this exact AC has independently verified compressor, defrost and minimum-cycle protections
data.climate_dry_fan_windowless_confirmed: Permit native DRY/FAN_ONLY switching without a window contact (extra consent)
data.climate_dry_fan_mode_dwell_s: Minimum native DRY/FAN_ONLY mode dwell (seconds; at least 1800)
data.climate_humidity_power_auto: Allow automatic power control of verified dedicated humidifier/dehumidifier (separate opt-in; draft only)
data.climate_humidity_power_hardware_confirme: I confirm dedicated equipment has independent tank, frost, overheating and compressor protection
data.climate_humidity_power_windowless_confir: Allow moisture control in this room without a window contact (extra opt-in)
data.climate_humidity_power_min_off_s: Minimum observed power-off dwell before restarting (seconds)
data.climate_secondary_climate_setpoint_auto: Allow setpoint-only control of already-on secondary heating/cooling thermostats (extra opt-in)

data_description.climate_heat_climate_entity: Optional same-room heat-only radiator or heating-zone climate.* entity. It must actually support HEAT; it never receives cooling commands.
data_description.climate_cool_climate_entity: Optional same-room air conditioner or cooling heat-pump climate.* entity. It must support COOL; manual OFF is respected.
data_description.climate_dry_climate_entity: Optional climate.* device with real native DRY. DRY-only devices provide humidity advice without fabricated temperature setpoints; automatic mode control is separately commissioned.
data_description.climate_fan_climate_entity: Optional climate.* device exposing FAN_ONLY. Do not assume an arbitrary air conditioner can safely switch to fan mode.
data_description.climate_humidifier_entity: Optional HA humidifier.* adding moisture. Select only a matching same-room device; automatic setpoint/power changes need separate authorization.
data_description.climate_dehumidifier_entity: Optional HA dehumidifier.* removing moisture. Compressor-equipped units need independent frost, tank and cycle protections.
data_description.climate_extraction_fan_entity: Optional same-room fan.* extracting air, driven by verified CO₂/ventilation demand. Merely selecting the entity does not power it on.
data_description.climate_purifier_fan_entity: Optional same-room fan.* used as air purifier for measured PM2.5. Filtration capability must be real; plain ventilation is not HEPA purification.
data_description.climate_humidity_entity: Select one fresh independent same-room RH sensor (%). Humidity controls hold rather than guess when this measurement is missing.
data_description.climate_humidity_low_rh: Lower desired relative humidity (%) for humidifier advice. Sustained values below it may cause discomfort; prevents over-drying.
data_description.climate_humidity_high_rh: Upper desired relative humidity (%) for dehumidification advice. Persistent high RH can promote condensation and mold on cold surfaces.
data_description.climate_humidity_hysteresis_rh: RH percentage-point margin before changing humidify/dry decisions. Prevents repeated switching around a target.
data_description.climate_cooling_dry_deferral_rh_points: While AC is already cooling, defer separate dehumidification until RH exceeds the upper target by this extra number of points. Set zero to disable deferral.
data_description.climate_humidity_setpoint_auto: Separate permission to adjust humidity targets of an already-running native humidifier. Does not power on equipment or overrule manual settings.
data_description.climate_window_efficiency_notify: Notify only when measured safe outdoor air could genuinely replace part of active heating/cooling/drying. Advisory only: never opens windows or shuts equipment off.
data_description.climate_dry_fan_mode_auto: Experimental opt-in for supported native DRY/FAN_ONLY transitions. Requires exact-device commissioning, mode dwell and independent compressor protections.
data_description.climate_dry_fan_hardware_confirmed: Installer attests independent compressor minimum-OFF, defrost, electrical and manufacturer protections on this exact AC. A checkbox alone cannot verify hardware.
data_description.climate_dry_fan_windowless_confirmed: Extra explicit consent when native DRY/FAN_ONLY switching must work without a verified room window contact. Does not bypass other safety interlocks.
data_description.climate_dry_fan_mode_dwell_s: Minimum seconds between automatic DRY/FAN_ONLY mode changes; at least 1800 seconds. Avoids aggressive switching but cannot replace physical compressor protection.
data_description.climate_humidity_power_auto: Separate experimental permission to turn verified dedicated humidifier/dehumidifier power on/off. Requires hardware protection, measured RH and strict runtime bounds.
data_description.climate_humidity_power_hardware_confirme: Attest independent overflow, frost, overtemperature, electrical and any compressor-cycle protections appropriate to this exact humidity device.
data_description.climate_humidity_power_windowless_confir: Extra consent to run dedicated moisture equipment in this room without a known window contact. Does not waive source freshness or safety bounds.
data_description.climate_humidity_power_min_on_s: Minimum number of seconds dedicated humidity equipment must run before a supervised OFF is attempted, unless independent physical protection intervenes.
data_description.climate_humidity_power_min_off_s: Minimum verified OFF duration before another managed humidity-device start. Avoid rapid compressor cycling; never bypass manufacturer limits.
data_description.climate_humidity_power_max_on_s: Maximum continuous controller-owned run time in seconds for a humidifier or dehumidifier. Triggers bounded OFF/reconciliation.
data_description.climate_secondary_climate_setpoint_auto: Separate opt-in to adjust the temperature setpoint of an already-running secondary heat/cool climate device. Never powers it on or changes unsupported modes.

climate_air_strategy.title: Climate - ventilation and air purification
climate_air_strategy.description: Select an actual same-room CO2/PM2.5 sensor, confirm NDIR/PM sensor quality, and optionally permit bounded speed increases only for already-on fans. No on/off, preset, AC mode or compressor commands are permitted.

data.climate_fan_speed_auto: Allow speed-only adjustment of already-on extraction/purifier fans (extra opt-in)
data.climate_fan_power_auto: Allow guarded automatic on/off for dedicated extraction/purifier fan.* devices (separate draft opt-in)
data.climate_fan_power_hardware_confirmed: I confirm independent electrical, backdraft, fire and ventilation-pressure protections on selected fans
data.climate_fan_power_max_on_s: Maximum continuous controller-owned fan operating time (seconds)
data.climate_pm25_sensor_verified: I have verified this is a real PM2.5 measurement, not an estimated index
data.climate_co2_entity: Selected true indoor CO₂ sensor (NDIR verification in environmental room setup)
data.climate_pm25_action_ug_m3: Short-term PM2.5 operational fan threshold (µg/m³; not WHO exposure guidance)
data.climate_extraction_speed_percent: Highest target speed for already-on extraction fan (%)
data.climate_purifier_speed_percent: Highest target speed for already-on purifier fan (%)

data_description.climate_fan_speed_auto: Separate permission to increase percentage only on an already-running extraction or purifier fan with verified air measurements. Never changes fan power.
data_description.climate_fan_power_auto: Experimental opt-in for bounded ON/OFF of the exact room fan.* device, using verified demand and hardware safety. Cannot share ownership with fan-speed automation.
data_description.climate_fan_power_hardware_confirmed: Attest the selected extractor/purifier has independent electrical, fire, backdraft and ventilation pressure protection suitable for automatic switching.
data_description.climate_fan_power_min_on_s: Minimum fan ON seconds after an authorized activation, before an automated OFF. Avoid rapid toggling but do not bypass required emergency cutouts.
data_description.climate_fan_power_min_off_s: Minimum observed fan OFF seconds before another permitted start. Hardware protection still applies independently.
data_description.climate_fan_power_max_on_s: Maximum duration in seconds that this controller can own an active fan. Exceeding it requests safe shutdown or manual reconciliation.
data_description.climate_pm25_sensor_verified: Confirm that the selected sensor directly measures PM2.5 mass concentration (µg/m³), not an uncalibrated proxy or arbitrary AQI.
data_description.climate_co2_entity: True same-room CO₂ sensor in ppm, preferably verified NDIR, used for demand-based extraction. eCO₂ from VOC is not equivalent.
data_description.climate_pm25_entity: Same-room PM2.5 µg/m³ sensor used for filtration control. Missing or unsupported data cannot start a purifier.
data_description.climate_pm25_action_ug_m3: Operational instantaneous PM2.5 threshold (µg/m³) for purifier-fan demand. Not a WHO daily exposure limit; a short spike is interpreted conservatively.
data_description.climate_extraction_speed_percent: Maximum extraction-fan speed (%) when verified CO₂ demand requires more airflow. Applies only to a supported fan already ON.
data_description.climate_purifier_speed_percent: Maximum purifier-fan speed (%) when PM2.5 demand exists. Changing percentage does not switch power or confirm filter efficiency.

climate_profiles.title: Climate - temperature bands for each mode
climate_profiles.description: Configure each selected room independently. A fresh room temperature sensor and exact room-assigned actuators are required. Direct relay/PWM is permitted only for independently protected non-compressor loads, with confirmed on/off limits and explicit actuation opt-in. data_description.global_threshold_outdoor_aqi: If outdoor AQI exceeds this configured provider-scale threshold, window opening is blocked. The default assumes US AQI; confirm the selected provider's scale.
data_description.global_threshold_outdoor_co2: Outdoor CO₂ screening ceiling in ppm. A confirmed reading above this value makes outside air unsuitable for ventilation advice; missing readings remain marked incomplete.
data_description.global_threshold_outdoor_pm25: Outdoor PM2.5 screening threshold in µg/m³. Higher measured particle levels block opening. This checks instantaneous readings, not WHO 24-hour compliance.
data_description.global_threshold_outdoor_pm10: Outdoor PM10 screening threshold in µg/m³. Valid elevated readings block ventilation suggestions; not a substitute for time-averaged exposure assessment.

data_description.global_threshold_outdoor_no2: Operational outdoor NO₂ screening threshold (µg/m³). High readings discourage ventilation; this instantaneous decision value is not a WHO averaging-period limit.
data_description.global_threshold_outdoor_o3: Operational outdoor ground-level ozone threshold (µg/m³). Elevated ozone can irritate airways; this screen does not replace hourly or daily exposure limits.
data_description.global_threshold_outdoor_so2: Operational outdoor sulfur dioxide threshold (µg/m³). Elevated readings block opening advice; this is not an official timed exposure standard.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_aqi: If indoor AQI exceeds this threshold, the integration looks for an opportunity to ventilate only when outdoor air and weather are suitable. Match the sensor's AQI scale.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_co2: Indoor CO₂ in ppm used to recommend increased fresh-air ventilation. Elevated CO₂ can indicate insufficient ventilation, but low CO₂ does not guarantee healthy air.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_pm25: Indoor PM2.5 in µg/m³ used to identify particle exposure and consider ventilation when outdoor particles are lower. This instant screen is not the WHO 24-hour mean.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_pm10: Indoor PM10 in µg/m³ used for air-quality attention and safe ventilation comparison. Higher levels can irritate the respiratory system; avoid outside air if worse.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_voc: Indoor VOC in µg/m³ used to flag possible sources such as cleaners or furnishings. Recommendations require safer outside air; individual VOC sensors are not universal health monitors.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_voc_parts: Indoor VOC measurement in ppb. Above the configured value the room may need ventilation, subject to outdoor safety. ppb cannot generally be converted to µg/m³ without a reference gas.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_humidity: Upper indoor relative humidity (%) for ventilation recommendations. Sustained high humidity may promote condensation and mold; a single reading is not a mold diagnosis.
data_description.global_threshold_min_outdoor_temp: Below this outdoor temperature (°C), window-opening advice is blocked to limit cold-air discomfort and heating losses. This does not control the heating device.
data_description.global_threshold_max_outdoor_temp: Above this outdoor temperature (°C), window-opening advice is blocked to avoid bringing in hot air. Climate actuators retain their independent controls.

data_description.global_threshold_max_age_minutes: Maximum permitted age of an outdoor sensor report in minutes. Older data are marked stale and are not treated as proof that outdoor air is safe or unsafe.
data_description.global_threshold_indoor_mold: Estimated critical-surface relative humidity (%) that triggers moisture/mold-risk ventilation advice. This is a physics-based indication, not detection of mold spores.
